src: nonblank marker mask s inside a 5x5 tile
dst: 5x5 tile slot d in the ordered 3x3 tile array
match_cond: sign(s.marker_centroid - tile_center) == d.position relative to the array center
transform: move each mask to its matched slot; generate absent slots by the agreed dihedral symmetry of known masks in the same orbit; refill tile backgrounds with the frequent nonblack color
